description: This PHP class represents a model used in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin API for bulk processing of leave entitlements matching employees. It encapsulates employee and entitlement details, provides serialization methods, and enforces unique entitlements per employee.

classes.name: BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel
classes.description: A model class for representing multiple employees and their leave entitlement data in bulk operations within the OrangeHRM leave plugin API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with arrays of Employee objects, LeaveEntitlement objects, and an optional entitlement value.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model data into an array suitable for API responses, aligning entitlements with employees.

methods.name: getEntitlementArrayWithEmpNumberAsKey
methods.description: Returns an array mapping employee numbers to their respective LeaveEntitlement objects, throwing an exception if duplicates are found.
